items.docs: Determine the meta fields available when filtering commissions. This endpoint returns either the default set of meta fields, or a custom set which replaces the default fields.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: The ID of the campaign to list the commission tiers for

items.docs: Returns the meta fields available when defining commission tiers. This endpoint returns campaign meta fields, plus meta fields that can be used to refine commission tiers, but not commission rates.
